statement: For every integer n >= 496, with D(n), G(n,a), R_n(a), and rho(n) defined exactly as in source.md, rho(n) < 1.
contribution: A complete proof split into an exhaustive exact-integer verification of every row 496 <= n <= 100000 and a uniform analytic bound for all n >= 100001. The tail localizes a row maximizer via the supplied adjacent-ratio polynomial, derives x^2 < n for x = n - 2a, and combines explicit one-sided Stirling bounds with a rationally certified endpoint majorant 24957787612296876183/25000000000000000000 < 1. Both parity classes and possible adjacent maximizing ties are covered.
